summary.prose: Build the pure coverage and editorial-validation layer, then author and evaluate a seed across Web, iOS and Android with concrete declarative examples. Human approval of the exact seed content is a separate required milestone before bundling. Finalization reuses existing eligibility and hash contracts; installation and retrieval remain later-story work.

tasks.title: Define coverage contracts and fixed rubric
tasks.summary: Define coverage contracts and fixed rubric within the approved S003 boundary.
acceptanceChecks: Exact closed sc4 CoverageReport/Cell schemas reuse S001 domain/UI/identity types and preserve all HLD fields; add closed internal specimen, evaluation and editorial dossier schemas without coercion/defaults/unknown fields.

Detached bounded snapshots reject malformed/adversarial inputs using existing issue codes; enforce 30 exact cells and the six named v1 cross-platform definitions, unique references and deterministic ordering.
This task implements structural decode/rubric definitions only, from LLD §§2.1 and 3.1–3.5; semantic specimen, case, human-decision and coverage checks remain t2–t5.

tests.name: coverage-schema preserves sc4 and rejects malformed duplicate or unsupported inputs

tasks.title: Validate safe declarative specimens
tasks.summary: Validate safe declarative specimens within the approved S003 boundary.
acceptanceChecks: Implement the approved specimen shape in coverage/specimens.ts: bounded JSON, unique IDs, finite nonnegative values/order, exact role/state/unit unions and record/UI/kind/reference matching.

Reject executable/remote fields and references; plain text stays inert and any review rendering escapes it. Validate lightweight palette, typography, state and layout evidence without claiming browser/device fidelity or accessibility certification.

tests.name: specimen-safety rejects executable remote malformed and unbounded content

tasks.title: Evaluate content-bound local cases
tasks.summary: Evaluate content-bound local cases within the approved S003 boundary.
acceptanceChecks: Implement pure definitions/results validation and deterministic check recomputation; resolve exact record versions and specimen bytes, role-constrained local evidence and complete observations.

Compute acyclic definition/subject digests; fabricate no editorial pass. All six cross-platform definitions target all three UI types with positive/misuse evidence; fail unknown/missing/duplicate/stale observations, IDs or cases.

tests.name: evaluation-binding rejects stale definitions records specimens and fabricated results

tasks.title: Bind explicit human editorial decisions
tasks.summary: Bind explicit human editorial decisions within the approved S003 boundary.
acceptanceChecks: Validate the separate maintainer-controlled human dossier against packaged decisions and exact record/case/cell subject digests, identities, UTC times and complete approval set.

Missing/rejected/stale/duplicate/conflicting decisions fail; match sc1 record.review and cell reviewers; preserve inferred authorship and S002 author/rationale lineage. No generator, code review, LLD approval or synthetic fixture may stamp production human decisions.
Document and test the record/case/cell review ordering and digest projections without dossier/report/final-release self-dependencies.

tests.name: editorial-binding requires explicit matching human decisions and preserves inferred authorship

tasks.title: Assess complete domain and platform coverage
tasks.summary: Assess complete domain and platform coverage within the approved S003 boundary.
acceptanceChecks: Implement pure coverage assessment over complete validated candidate and separately supplied editorial dossier; require every record in every declared applicable cell and matching substantive domain/platform cases.

Reconstruct case/approval evidence independently; reject missing/gap/duplicate/inapplicable cells, failed cross-platform cases, changed content and draft/relabelled guidance. Computable invalid candidates yield passed=false; noncomputable identities yield ValidationResult failure.
Emit only stage=coverage bound to corrected candidateContentDigest; reuse S001/S002 without changing their schemas or replacing eligibility.

tests.name: coverage-matrix rejects missing gap duplicate or inapplicable domain-platform cells
coverage-determinism preserves canonical identities and stable diagnostics

tasks.title: Finalize candidates without hash cycles
tasks.summary: Finalize candidates without hash cycles within the approved S003 boundary.
acceptanceChecks: Compose S002 eligible noncoverage inventory plus one declared coverage placeholder; canonicalize sc4 bytes, fill raw coverage digest, then reviewDigest and releaseId using existing S001 helpers.

Independently re-run eligibility, validateRelease, coverage and checkPublication on final bytes; any failure returns no eligible package; include all editorial/evaluation outputs in S002 lineage and reject unused source material.
Prove record/specimen/evidence/role/media-type mutations invalidate reviews or assessments; no installation/catalog/publication/default or project-state mutation.

tests.name: candidate-coverage finalizes without hash cycles and rejects stale assessments
candidate-coverage withholds draft rejected or relabelled inferred guidance

tasks.title: Author visual foundation drafts and examples
tasks.summary: Author visual foundation drafts and examples within the approved S003 boundary.
acceptanceChecks: Create substantive draft guidance for Visual style, Layout, Color and Typography across Web/iOS/Android under design/corpus-seed/v1/, with per-platform positive/misuse examples and applicable domain payloads.
Include concrete semantic palette pairings, typography hierarchy/expansion, layout priority/adaptation and controllable visual treatments; explicit checks/limits, tradeoffs, provenance and relations.
Generated guidance is inferred and unreviewed; verify normative claims against primary sources during authoring or clearly scope as heuristics. No unapproved imports or draft assets under src/assets.

tests.name: draft-visual-seed contains applicable visual foundations and examples without review stamps

tasks.title: Author interaction and feedback drafts
tasks.summary: Author interaction and feedback drafts within the approved S003 boundary.
acceptanceChecks: Add Navigation and flows, Components and states, and Motion and feedback coverage for all three UI types, with explicit platform units/behavior and positive/misuse examples.
Exercise navigation/context recovery, control states and meaningful motion/reduced-motion cases using the approved declarative format; maintain explicit check limits and inferred/draft provenance.
Extend the authoring roster and local case evidence while preserving broken-reference/duplicate detection; no human approval or publication labels fabricated.

tests.name: draft-interaction-seed covers platform behavior and state examples without fabricated review

tasks.title: Complete inclusive adaptation and style recipes
tasks.summary: Complete inclusive adaptation and style recipes within the approved S003 boundary.
acceptanceChecks: Add Inclusive design, Platform adaptation, and Content and trust across all UI types, covering the LLD rubric and completing proposed evidence for all 30 cells and six cross-platform cases.
Author at least three coherent style recipes with composition/typography/color/interaction, conditions/tradeoffs and platform examples; names are discovery aids, not industry stereotypes.
Complete draft roster, provenance/lineage and review checklist for actual seed records/specimens/cases; all content stays outside bundled assets and unreviewed until explicit human decisions.

tests.name: draft-seed-roster covers all domains and coherent style recipes while remaining unapproved

tasks.title: Review the actual seed and record human decisions
tasks.summary: Review the actual seed and record human decisions within the approved S003 boundary.
acceptanceChecks: Present concrete actual seed records, specimens, complete case observations, exact review subjects and reviewer/maintainer identity for explicit human editorial review; prepare all evidence before asking.
Record only actual explicit human decisions, resolve rejection/staleness and update sc1 review fields consistently; LLD/PLAN approval and daemon code review do not approve seed content.

Run actual seed coverage proving all 30 cells and six cross-platform evaluations. Without human approval, keep this task and S003 completion pending; synthetic fixtures can test machinery but cannot satisfy this acceptance check.

Preserve durable evidence of the human's actual decision and exact subject digests separately from test execution. Archive actual-seed coverage output; tests of synthetic approval data cannot stand in for human review.

tests.name: seed-coverage proves all domain-platform cells and mandatory cross-platform cases

tasks.title: Bundle only the reviewed immutable seed
tasks.summary: Bundle only the reviewed immutable seed within the approved S003 boundary.
acceptanceChecks: Finalize the approved actual seed and place only its eligible immutable package under src/assets/design-corpus/releases/<releaseId>/ with the approved versioned bundled descriptor.

Add separate bounded local maintainer verification tooling; reject unsafe paths/symlinks and executable/remote specimens, and verify exact records, specimen/evaluation/editorial files, source lineage and notices.

Verify copied out/assets bytes match reviewed source package, drafts remain outside distribution and fresh independent eligibility/coverage preflight passes. Do not add S004 catalog/install/retrieval or S005 publication behavior.
Run named local-reader symlink/path/byte-limit rejection and built-asset byte-parity tests in this task, before the final pure-isolation sweep.

tests.name: seed-bundle ships only reviewed eligible immutable content with complete notices
seed-reader rejects unsafe local packages and preserves copied asset bytes

tasks.title: Verify pure boundaries and complete the handoff
tasks.summary: Verify pure boundaries and complete the handoff within the approved S003 boundary.
acceptanceChecks: Compile fresh pure coverage entries and execute real assessment/finalization with filesystem/network/subprocess/native access forbidden; keep local maintainer I/O separate.

Run accumulated corpus regression suite and strict build on supported Node; preserve unabridged results and disclose unrelated broader failures. Every preceding task already runs its mapped tests at its own gate.
Document seed review/rebuild process and S004/S005 handoff; request independent daemon code review, preserve findings, then request explicit BUILD completion approval without auto-approval.

tests.name: coverage-isolation compiles pure modules and assesses candidates with I/O forbidden
strict-build compiles coverage and passes the full corpus regression suite
